trends.name: Iran-Israel Escalation & Oil Supply Disruption
trends.summary: Fresh Israeli strikes on Iran March 20 escalate Middle East conflict despite Trump's warnings. Iran now charging $2M+ per oil tanker for Strait of Hormuz passage; Saudi officials warn oil could spike past $180/barrel if disruptions persist through late April. Netanyahu signals willingness for ground operations and alternative shipping routes, creating sustained geopolitical risk premium on energy markets.

trends.name: Big Tech CapEx Concerns & AI Spending Bubble
trends.summary: 22% of global fund managers now believe tech companies are over-deploying CapEx—second-highest on record. Concerns about unsustainable AI infrastructure spending paired with Nvidia's $1T forecast being called 'peak' signals potential revaluation of mega-cap tech stocks and AI-driven valuations that may not justify returns.

trends.name: Fed Rate Cut Timeline Off The Table
trends.summary: Treasury yields climbing sharply as bond market signals Fed rate cuts likely postponed or cancelled through 2026. Market fear grows that inflation and geopolitical uncertainty are preventing the monetary easing investors had priced in, reshaping fixed income and equity growth narratives.

trends.name: Private Credit Liquidity Crisis
trends.summary: Private credit investors rushing for exits amid deteriorating credit conditions. Larry McDonald's Bear Traps Report highlights mounting stress in private credit markets, signaling potential spillover effects into leveraged lending, M&A, and private equity performance.

trends.name: Retail Earnings Mixed Amid Margin Pressures
trends.summary: Q4 2025 earnings transcripts from DG, OLLI, LULU, WSM, FIVE show consumer spending resilience but structural cost pressures. Dollar General and Ollie's face inventory challenges; Lululemon and Williams-Sonoma navigate margin compression from inflation and supply chain costs, signaling retail sector divergence.

trends.name: UK Sovereign Debt Crisis & Global Bond Yields
trends.summary: UK 10-year bond yields surge past 5% for first time since 2008, coinciding with broader global sovereign debt concerns. Fitch also revises New Zealand's outlook to negative, signaling rising fiscal stress across developed economies and potential contagion to corporate credit markets.

trends.name: Super Micro Computer Smuggling Scandal & Supply Chain Risk
trends.summary: Super Micro shares collapse 25-28% after co-founder and employees indicted for smuggling Nvidia AI chips to China. Raises critical questions about U.S. export controls on semiconductor technology, supply chain integrity for AI chip producers, and geopolitical risk in critical tech manufacturing.

trends.name: ECB Rate Hike Scenario & Central Bank Divergence
trends.summary: ECB's Makhlouf signals two price hikes as baseline scenario, contrasting sharply with Fed rate cut expectations. Meanwhile BoE forecasted to cut rates in late 2026. Central bank policy divergence is reshaping currency markets and capital flows between USD, EUR, and GBP.

trends.name: ARM Stock Momentum & AI Chip Design Leadership
trends.summary: Wall Street analysts increasingly bullish on ARM, predicting 50% upside as investors recognize its 'game-changing' position in AI chip design. ARM licensing architecture to Nvidia, Apple, and other AI leaders positions it as foundational infrastructure play with optionality across AI deployment models.

trends.name: Social Security Insolvency & Entitlement Reform Risk
trends.summary: Multiple reports highlight Social Security benefit cuts coming by 2032 if Congress doesn't act, with current retirees facing direct hits. Debate over 'retirement age' and longevity trends adds political urgency to entitlement reform, creating fiscal policy uncertainty for government spending and bond markets.

trends.name: Trump Admin AI Policy & Tech Regulation Framework
trends.summary: Trump administration unveils national AI policy framework explicitly designed to limit state regulatory power. Signals pro-innovation, light-touch approach to AI governance that favors Big Tech but creates political economy risks as states push back, affecting valuations of major AI players.

trends.name: Regional Banking Sector Uncertainty & Deposit Stress
trends.summary: The Bancorp and Toronto-Dominion Bank both flagged as 'fundamentally resilient but nearly fully priced,' signaling limited upside despite stability. Ongoing deposit competition and regional bank consolidation (Nexstar-Tegna merger) suggest sector valuations have reflected most positive catalysts.
